description: The Kerala Police has claimed to have solved a 19-year-old murder case with the help of artificial intelligence (AI), leading to the arrest of two former armymen for allegedly killing a woman and her 17-day-old twin children in 2006
body_lead: Kerala police use AI to crack 19-year-old triple murder case The Kerala Police has claimed to have solved a 19-year-old murder case with the help of artificial intelligence (AI), leading to the arrest of two former armymen for allegedly killing a woman and her 17-day-old twin children in 2006 The Kerala Police has claimed to have solved a 19-year-old triple murder case with the help of artificial intelligence (AI). In a case of murder of a woman and her 17-day-old twins in 2006, the Kerala Police last week arrested two former armymen with the help of AI, according to The Indian Express.
